Anthony Fenech
Tigers beat writer
Detroit Free Press
(734) 752-9667
Twitter: @anthonyfenech
From: Fenech, Anthony
Sent: Saturday, September 2, 2017 5:21 PM
To: Crawford, Kirkland <kcrawford@freepress.com>
Subject: Re: Victor 
 
I know... I was unsure when Francona was going to talk so I went over there immediately. 45 minutes later, he did.

Twitter: @anthonyfenech
From: Crawford, Kirkland
Sent: Saturday, September 2, 2017 5:06:17 PM
To: Fenech, Anthony
Subject: RE: Victor 
 
Update it when you can.
But in the future, three graphs and a cloud a dust is all we need if that’s all you got. Better to have something than nothing.

From: Fenech, Anthony 
Sent: Saturday, September 02, 2017 5:05 PM
To: Crawford, Kirkland <kcrawford@freepress.com>
Subject: Victor

I'm sorry man, doing the best I can here. Seriously. Victor gets announced and I waited for Francona's media session because he had the same thing. The meantime i'm still trying to fish Al out for some more details on the Verlander trade.

Anthony Fenech
Tigers beat writer
Detroit Free Press
(734) 752-9667
Twitter: @anthonyfenech
From: Fenech, Anthony
Sent: Friday, September 22, 2017 6:27 PM
To: Thomas, Christopher <cdthomas@freepress.com>
Subject: Re: Victor 
 
Katie Strang.

Twitter: @anthonyfenech
From: Thomas, Christopher
Sent: Friday, September 22, 2017 6:27:19 PM
To: Fenech, Anthony
Subject: RE: Victor 
 
I just think the Victor stuff is part of a bigger-issue story. It doesn’t feel right in this space, and frankly we don’t have the space to give to it. I want to let that thing breathe.
Who do you think is going to scoop you and what do we lose if we publish early in the a.m.?

From: Fenech, Anthony 
Sent: Friday, September 22, 2017 6:21 PM
To: Thomas, Christopher <cdthomas@freepress.com>
Subject: Re: Victor
I'm not talking about a separate story, but I'm going to mention it as part of the clubhouse concerns in this story.

From: Thomas, Christopher
Sent: Friday, September 22, 2017 6:15:40 PM
To: Fenech, Anthony
Subject: RE: Victor
We don’t have the capacity for that story right now.

I can take it tonight and have it published in the a.m., but at that point, I’d just get your enterprise ready. 
I’d make your story today as efficient as you can, then bust out the enterprise.

From: Fenech, Anthony 
Sent: Friday, September 22, 2017 6:09 PM
To: Thomas, Christopher <cdthomas@freepress.com>
Subject: Re: Victor
Today... I just think there's a chance that we get beat by Sunday.

From: Thomas, Christopher
Sent: Friday, September 22, 2017 6:08 PM
To: Fenech, Anthony
Subject: RE: Victor
In the story today or for Sunday?
